risk_note: RV2 by path (apps/admin globs; no money logic). Admin platform icons page (two): upload one key at a time as multipart through the data provider (FormData passed as the body without a content-type, JSON requests unchanged), cancellable upload (abort, late responses dropped), cleaned preview on light and dark backgrounds beside the built-in images with a confirmation that resets per upload, the three 20001 file reasons and 413, save as version (draft when a source field is missing), source register / correct with the version revision; plus the two F1-06zd review S2 (publish / rollback / restore use the identifier revision captured when the modal opened; history paging on antd Pagination). Rule tests by a Claude subagent (jsdom 45 + browser 6), Codex read-only test review 2 rounds (round 1: two coverage gaps), red on the test machine (red/16, 51 tests). Implementation by Codex in 2 rounds (round 2: a dependency cycle and two visual details from the orchestrator's screen-by-screen comparison with the frozen boards). Test machine verify-fast/7 and browser/7 green. Review: fresh Claude subagent (id 27). Written by hand.
